messages.author: Célia Baptiste
messages.text: Line 2 went to three stations after the May rebalance — the old layout sheet still says two. Sets per station is one for the clamp gauge.

messages.author: Folake Adeyemi
messages.text: Rear harness tray is the 27th, so it is not part of next week's count. The old tray B booking was cancelled and rebooked; count it once.

messages.author: Sören Lindqvist
messages.text: No expedited build on this one unless it comes to me; transfers from Kelbrook need my sign-off too.
